# onedrive-app-data API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/documentation.cjs. Do not edit. -->

Read and replace user/application JSON files through Graph metadata and app-root content endpoints.

## SPFxOneDriveAppDataReadResult

JSON read outcome. T describes expected data and does not validate it.

### Imports

```ts
import type { SPFxOneDriveAppDataReadResult } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
```

### Examples

```ts
import { SPFxOneDriveAppDataReadResult, SPFxOneDriveAppDataService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

async function exampleUsage(appData: SPFxOneDriveAppDataService) {

  if (!result.isNotFound) console.log(result.data?.theme);
}
```

## SPFxOneDriveAppDataService

JSON reads and writes in the authenticated user's OneDrive app root. Requires a caller-owned Graph client with app-folder read/write grants and native fetch for reads. No cache, retry or folder creation is added. Dates, undefined and other non-JSON values do not round-trip losslessly.

### Imports (2)

```ts
import type { SPFxOneDriveAppDataService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxOneDriveAppDataService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/services';
```

### Examples (2)

```ts
import type { MSGraphClientV3 } from '@microsoft/sp-http';
import { SPFxOneDriveAppDataService, createSPFxOneDriveAppDataService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

async function exampleUsage(graphClient: MSGraphClientV3) {
  const appData: SPFxOneDriveAppDataService = createSPFxOneDriveAppDataService(graphClient);
  await appData.write('settings.json', { theme: 'dark' }, 'dashboard');
}
```

### Members (2)

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `SPFxOneDriveAppDataService.read` | `<T = unknown>(fileName: string, folder?: string \| undefined) => Promise<SPFxOneDriveAppDataReadResult<T>>` | Required | — | Reads metadata through Graph, then downloads JSON from its preauthenticated<br>HTTPS URL using native fetch without authorization headers or cookies.<br>This avoids Graph's browser-incompatible authenticated /content redirect. |
| `SPFxOneDriveAppDataService.write` | `<T = unknown>(fileName: string, content: T, folder?: string \| undefined) => Promise<void>` | Required | — | Writes JSON through Graph; existing content is replaced. |

##### Type parameters (2)

- `T`: Expected deserialized value; defaults to unknown and performs no runtime validation.

##### Parameters

- `fileName`: File name, passed into the Graph path without sanitization.
- `folder`: Omitted or empty selects app root; other values replace characters outside letters, digits, hyphen and underscore with hyphens. Distinct inputs can collide after sanitization.

Parsed data, or isNotFound with undefined data for a missing file.

- `content`: JSON-serializable value; generic types do not validate serialization.
- `folder`: Omitted or empty selects app root; non-alphanumeric characters except hyphen/underscore become hyphens. No folder creation is performed.

Resolves after Graph accepts the write.

## SPFxOneDriveAppDataService.read

Reads metadata through Graph, then downloads JSON from its preauthenticated
HTTPS URL using native fetch without authorization headers or cookies.
This avoids Graph's browser-incompatible authenticated /content redirect.

Source-owned support type; no public named import.

### Throws (3)

- Graph, download, invalid metadata or JSON parsing errors.

### Examples (4)

```ts
import { SPFxOneDriveAppDataService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

async function exampleUsage(appData: SPFxOneDriveAppDataService) {
  const result = await appData.read<{ theme: string }>('settings.json', 'my-app');
}
```


## createSPFxOneDriveAppDataService

Creates explicit app-root JSON operations without React context or state.

### Imports (3)

```ts
import { createSPFxOneDriveAppDataService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import { createSPFxOneDriveAppDataService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit/services';
```

### Use when

- You store JSON files private to the signed-in user and this Graph application in OneDrive app root.

### Examples (5)

#### Basic usage

```ts
import type { MSGraphClientV3 } from '@microsoft/sp-http';
import { createSPFxOneDriveAppDataService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

async function exampleUsage(graphClient: MSGraphClientV3) {
  const appData = createSPFxOneDriveAppDataService(graphClient);
  const settings = await appData.read<{ theme: string }>('settings.json');
}
```

#### Read and replace app-folder JSON

```ts
import type { MSGraphClientV3 } from '@microsoft/sp-http';

import { createSPFxOneDriveAppDataService } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
async function demonstrate(graphClient: MSGraphClientV3) {
  const data = createSPFxOneDriveAppDataService(graphClient);
  const result = await data.read<unknown>('settings.json', 'dashboard');
  if (!result.isNotFound) console.log(result.data);
  await data.write('settings.json', { theme: 'dark' }, 'dashboard');
}
```
